statements.statement: The procedure code billed is CPT 93229
The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness that persisted despite initial evaluation
The patient has a known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmic activity
The diagnosis codes submitted are I34.0 and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial was based on missing prior authorization
Prior authorization or precertification was required for this service
